items.text:
Hi Daniel,

My office hours shift this week to Wednesday, 2:00–4:00 PM in Room 312 instead of Thursday. Forms submitted after Friday at noon carry a $5 late fee. Please bring your signed advising sheet and a pen.

Best,
Dr. Alvarez

questions.stem: According to the email, what should Daniel bring?

options.A: A copy of his tuition receipt

questions.explanation: The email asks Daniel to bring 'your signed advising sheet and a pen.' The $5 fee is mentioned, but no receipt, voucher, or schedule is requested.

questions.stem: In the email, the word "shift" is closest in meaning to
questions.explanation: "Shift" indicates that the office hours have moved to a different day and time, so they are rescheduled. They do not stay the same, grow longer, or repeat.

items.text:
NOTICE: Recycling Bins Relocated

Effective March 3, the bins formerly at Lot C are moved to the north entrance of Baker Hall. Collection occurs 7:00–10:00 AM daily. Glass and cardboard must be separated; mixed containers will not be emptied. Questions: Facilities Office.

questions.stem: According to the notice, what is required of people using the bins?

options.B: Delivering bins to the Facilities Office

questions.explanation: The notice states that glass and cardboard must be separated, meaning these two materials have to be kept apart. No rinsing, delivery, or early arrival is mentioned.

questions.stem: What is implied by the statement that mixed containers will not be emptied?

options.A: Users must sort items before drop-off
options.B: Staff will sort the contents later
options.C: The bins will be taken away soon

questions.explanation: Since unsorted containers are left unemptied, users themselves must separate their recyclables before depositing them. The notice says nothing about staff sorting, bin removal, or changed collection hours.

items.text:
NOTICE: Network Maintenance

Wireless access in the Hartley Library will be unavailable on Saturday, April 12, from 11:00 PM to 3:00 AM Sunday while servers are upgraded. Wired connections in Room 110 remain active. Direct questions to the IT Help Desk, extension 4400.

questions.stem: During which period will wireless access be unavailable?

options.A: From Saturday night until early Sunday
options.B: From Saturday morning until Sunday night
options.C: From Friday night until Saturday morning
options.D: From Sunday afternoon until Monday morning

questions.explanation: The notice gives the window as 11:00 PM Saturday to 3:00 AM Sunday, which is Saturday night through early Sunday morning.

questions.stem: In the notice, the word "active" is closest in meaning to
questions.explanation: "Active" means the wired connections in Room 110 continue to function while the wireless network is down. It does not refer to being crowded, open to the public, or protected.
